title: Conditions of Booking: Several Keyturn Trip Bookings Held by One Guest
content:
A guest may hold more than one Keyturn Trip Booking reservation at a time and there is no ceiling on how many reservations a guest may open over their lifetime on the marketplace. Each reservation is a contract in its own right: it carries its own rate plan, its own allowance and its own balance, and nothing is netted between two reservations. Where a guest holds several reservations, each is priced, cancelled and settled on its own terms, and a credit raised on one reservation is never applied against the balance of another.

### The same condition, set out clause by clause

1. **Lifetime count.** The marketplace sets no maximum number of reservations one guest may open over their lifetime.
2. **Separateness.** Three things belong to the reservation and not to the guest: the rate plan it is priced under, the included-mile allowance granted to it, and the balance owed on it.
3. **No netting.** Nothing is netted between two reservations of the same guest.
4. **Separate treatment.** Pricing, cancellation and settlement are each performed on the terms of the reservation they concern.
5. **Credits.** A credit raised on one reservation is never applied against the balance of another.

### A question this condition answers

*A guest holds two Keyturn Trip Booking reservations, one of which carries a credit and the other a balance owed. Does the credit reduce the balance?* It does not. The credit was raised on the reservation it belongs to and is never applied against the balance of the other, because nothing is netted between two reservations.
